atlas-retail.title: Atlas Retail
atlas-retail.summary: A stock and sales dashboard that replaced eleven spreadsheets for a chain of nine stores.
atlas-retail.overview: Atlas ran nine stores on a shared folder of spreadsheets. Nobody knew real stock levels until the end of the month, and reorders were guesswork. We built one dashboard the whole chain works from.
atlas-retail.challenge: Every store kept its own file, in its own format, and merged them by hand each month. Numbers disagreed constantly, so managers stopped trusting the reports and ordered on instinct instead. The fix had to work for staff who had never used anything but Excel.
atlas-retail.solution: A single web app with live stock per store, transfers between branches, and a reorder view that flags items before they run out. We imported four years of history so the first screen a manager opened already had their own data in it. Training took one afternoon.
results: Stock counts went from monthly to live across all nine stores
Reorder decisions moved from instinct to flagged, dated alerts
Month-end reporting dropped from three days of merging to one click

nordwind-api.title: Nordwind API
nordwind-api.summary: A rebuilt ordering API that took a logistics platform from nightly batches to real-time.
nordwind-api.overview: Nordwind's partners wanted to see order status as it happened. The existing system answered with data that was up to a day old, because everything moved in a nightly batch job.
nordwind-api.challenge: The batch job was the only integration point, and eight partners had built against it. We could not simply switch it off. The new API had to run alongside the old one long enough for every partner to migrate on their own schedule.
nordwind-api.solution: We built a versioned REST API with webhooks for status changes, and kept the nightly export running as a thin layer on top of the new data model. Partners migrated one at a time over four months without a single coordinated cutover.
results: Order status went from up-to-24-hours stale to under a second
All eight partners migrated with no downtime and no shared cutover date
The nightly batch was retired after the last partner moved

lumen-studio.title: Lumen Studio
lumen-studio.summary: A booking flow redesign that cut abandoned bookings for a photography studio group.
lumen-studio.overview: Lumen books studio time by the hour across three locations. Most people who started a booking never finished it, and the team could not tell where they were dropping off.
lumen-studio.challenge: The old flow asked for payment details on the first screen, before showing whether the slot was even free. It also assumed a desktop screen, while most bookings were attempted on a phone during a lunch break.
lumen-studio.solution: We rebuilt the flow mobile-first: pick a location, see live availability, hold the slot for ten minutes, then pay. We added analytics on every step so the team can see exactly where people stop, instead of guessing.
results: Completed bookings rose sharply after the payment step moved last
The team can now see drop-off per step instead of guessing
Phone bookings became the majority channel within two months

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: It depends on what you need. Tell us about your project and we give you a clear, fixed price before any work starts. No hidden costs.
A first version usually takes a few weeks. A complete product takes longer. We give you a realistic timeline before we begin, and we keep you updated as we go.

faq.q: Do I own the final product?
faq.a: Yes. The code, the design, and all the accounts belong to you. Nothing is locked to us.

faq.q: What if I don't know exactly what I want yet?
faq.a: That is normal, and it is where we start. We help you turn a rough idea into a clear plan before anything gets built.
We do not disappear. We stay available to fix issues, make improvements, and help your product grow.

sections.heading: Agreement to Terms
sections.body: By using this website or working with CUVATEX, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: Services
sections.body: CUVATEX designs and builds software products — websites, web apps, mobile apps, product design, and custom backend systems. The exact scope of each project is agreed with the client before work starts.

sections.heading: Client Responsibilities
sections.body: Clients agree to give timely feedback, and to provide the content, access, and information needed to complete the work. Delays on the client's side can delay delivery.

sections.heading: Payment Terms
sections.body: Projects are priced with a fixed quote agreed before work starts. Invoices are due on the schedule agreed in the project proposal. Late payment may pause work until it is resolved.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: Once a project is paid in full, the client owns the final deliverables. CUVATEX may show completed work in its own portfolio unless the client asks otherwise in writing.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: CUVATEX works carefully, but is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from the use of a delivered product, to the extent allowed by law.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: Either party can end an engagement with written notice. Work completed up to that point is billed at the agreed rate.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: The jurisdiction that governs these terms is still to be decided, and will be confirmed here once set.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated from time to time. Continuing to use our services after a change means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Reach out through our contact page or by email.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This page explains what information CUVATEX collects through this website, and how it is used.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you use the contact form, we collect the name, email, and message you provide. We also collect basic, anonymous analytics about how visitors use the site.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use contact form details only to reply to your message. Analytics data is used in aggregate, to understand how the site is used and where it can be improved.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.body: Contact form submissions are processed by Web3Forms, a third-party form-delivery service, in order to deliver your message to us. We do not sell your information to anyone.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses Umami, a privacy-friendly analytics tool that does not use cookies and does not track visitors individually.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: Contact form messages are kept only as long as needed to respond to your inquiry, unless we are required to keep them longer by law.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You can ask us to access or delete any information we hold about you by contacting us through the email on our contact page.
